checks.proves: Client order, lifecycle and deep-link source/runtime contracts.
checks.doesNotProve: Cross-surface server transitions or live data.
checks.passCriteria: All app-client tests pass on exact candidate.

checks.proves: Targeted order, dispatch, pickup and partner-delivery state-machine rules.
DSH persistence, migration and lifecycle constraints used by fulfillment state.
Identity, DSH and WLT runtime dependencies needed by order lifecycle are reachable and truthfully ready.
checks.failCriteria: Required service is unavailable, false-ready or smoke fails.

checks.command: MANUAL exact-candidate prepare, assign, handoff, track, pickup, deliver, cancel, return, exception and reassignment scenarios including wrong actor, duplicate, stale version, restart and deep-link cases
checks.proves: Real client/partner/captain/operator convergence and privacy-safe client readback.
checks.doesNotProve: Independent financial control without WLT tests.
checks.passCriteria: Recorded evidence shows one legal DSH state/version, no cross-actor data leak and no duplicate consequence.
checks.failCriteria: Contradictory state, unauthorized data/action, duplicate effect, stale overwrite or false completion appears.
